name: DayExam
tagline: Exam question management and learning tool with AI-powered document parsing.
blurb: Day Exam is a powerful exam preparation app that helps you efficiently manage and study exam questions.
description:
Day Exam is a powerful exam preparation app that helps you efficiently manage and study exam questions. It now features advanced AI capabilities to parse documents and automatically generate test papers.

Key Features:
• Question Management - Import and organize various exam questions
• AI-Powered Test Paper Generation - Automatically parse documents to create test papers
• Learning Tracking - Record learning progress and answer statistics
• Multiple Question Types - Support for single choice, multiple choice, and more
• Focus Mode - Immersive learning experience

This app is completely open source, respects your privacy, and contains no tracking or advertisements.
